articles.title: Russia Stands United: West's Divide-and-Conquer Ploys Fall Flat, Int'l Experts Say
articles.description: Western powers have long sought to weaken Russia, exploit its resources, and undermine its internal unity, but the country has preserved its sovereignty despite mounting external pressure, analysts from Iran, Afghanistan, Turkiye, and Lebanon told Sputnik, commenting on President Vladimir Putin's remarks that foreign forces have repeatedly tried to break up Russia to eliminate it as a geopolitical competitor.

articles.title: French judges probe war crimes complaint against Israeli army in Lebanon: lawyer
articles.description: France has opened a judicial investigation into a war crimes complaint over an Israeli strike on a residential building in Lebanon, a lawyer told AFP on Tuesday. French-Lebanese artist Ali Cherri, whose parents were killed in the Beirut strike in 2024, filed the complaint as a civil party this year with the International Federation for Human Rights, Cherri's lawyer Clemence Bectarte explained.
